{{Quote|She's hooked up with a mercenary crew that includes a number of scary Trandoshans and along with Erran's two brothers: Hirsch and Doak, two very powerful soldiers.|A [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] report about [[Erran Sif]]|<ref name="10HSTG">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Travel%20Guide|text=10 Hot Spots Travel Guide}}</ref>}}
'''Doak Sif''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Sif]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:ES" /> A powerful [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], Doak was the brother of [[Hirsch Sif|Hirsch]] and [[Erran Sif]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], his sister Erran, who was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]], betrayed the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and was wanted by both for selling information to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. She had thus fled from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], where she assembled a group of mercenaries.<ref name="10HSTG" /> Doak and Hirsch Sif joined those mercenaries, based in a [[Sif bunker|bunker]] in the [[Akazi Plains]].<ref name="SWG:ES" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doak Sif was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ES" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
